fieldMarks: Very large: 64-74 cm, 2-3.5 kg, wingspan 1.1-1.3 m
Chestnut stripes around a pale face and throat
behavior: Displaying male gives a loud fluting whistle, plus chuckling clucks
Feeds on roots, tubers and seeds
Nest is a ground scrape, often sheltered by rocks or grass clumps; 4-6 eggs
range: In the US, NatureServe records the species in Nevada (introduced); Audubon calls its U.S. range limited.
